name: Tame Impala

whyMatters.en: Kevin Parker’s Perth project; Lonerism (2012) and Currents (2015) made solo-studio psychedelic pop a festival-headliner format.
whyMatters.zh: Kevin Parker 的珀斯项目；Lonerism（2012）与 Currents（2015）把一人录音室迷幻流行做成音乐节头条格式。

essentialTracks.title: The Less I Know the Better
Feels Like We Only Go Backwards

scenes.track: Feels Like We Only Go Backwards

note.zh: 紧凑 funk-迷幻流媒体钩子。

interviewQuotes.text: I just follow what sounds good.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Kevin Parker

lyricQuotes: I feel like I was living for you

shortBio.en: Parker psychedelic pop; Let It Happen and Less I Know are Currents poles.
shortBio.zh: Parker 迷幻流行；Let It Happen 与 Less I Know 是 Currents 两极。

body.en:
Begun mid-2000s; Parker writes/plays/produces most parts, touring band separate. Innerspeaker and Lonerism revive psych guitar; Currents pivots to disco-bass and processed vocal for global crossover.

Let It Happen (2015) and The Less I Know the Better (2015) show extended electronic build and concise funk-psych hook.
body.zh:
2000 年代中期起步；Parker 写作/演奏/制作大部分声部，巡演乐队另组。Innerspeaker 与 Lonerism 复兴迷幻吉他；Currents 转向迪斯科贝斯与处理人声以全球跨界。

Let It Happen（2015）与 The Less I Know the Better（2015）展示延长电子推进与紧凑 funk-迷幻钩子。

title.en: Solo studio psych as headliner brand
title.zh: 一人录音室迷幻作为头条品牌

body.en:
Tame Impala matter as proof a mostly-solo recording project can scale to festivals via meticulous production and a live band shell.

Parker’s method is the band.
body.zh:
Tame Impala 要紧处是证明：主要一人录音的项目可经精密制作与现场乐队外壳扩到音乐节。

Parker 的方法即乐队。

title.en: Let It Happen: long electronic build

body.en:
Loop breakdown mid-song, dance pulse, psych harmony—Currents’ extended single.

Studio accident/glitch aesthetic as arrangement.
body.zh:
曲中循环崩解、舞曲脉冲、迷幻和声——Currents 的延长单曲。

把录音室事故/毛刺美学当编曲。

title.en: Less I Know: compact funk-psych hook
title.zh: Less I Know：紧凑 funk-迷幻钩子

body.en:
Bass hook, falsetto, short runtime—streaming-era crossover object.

Concise where Let It Happen is expansive.
body.zh:
贝斯钩子、假声、短时长——流媒体时代跨界对象。

相对 Let It Happen 的扩展，此曲紧凑。

body.en:
Bedroom-to-arena path influences 2010s psych and indie-pop producers.

DNA is mix craft + melody, not jam length.
body.zh:
卧室到舞台的路径影响 2010 年代迷幻与 indie-pop 制作人。

DNA 是混音工艺 + 旋律，不是即兴时长。

body.en:
Interviews emphasize home-studio control and endless tweaking.

Method talk matches the credits list.
body.zh:
访谈强调家庭录音室控制与无尽微调。

方法谈话与credits 列表匹配。

note.en: Psych as dancefloor hypnosis for the streaming age.
note.zh: 流媒体时代的迷幻舞池催眠。
